description: This Dart source file defines the main administrative panel shell for a Flutter web application, including navigation, layout, session management, and sign-out functionality. It orchestrates the display of pages such as dashboard, books, categories, and users, with a sidebar and topbar, and handles authentication state.

classes.name: AdminPanelShell
classes.description: Main widget managing the admin interface, including authentication check, navigation, and page rendering.

classes.name: _NavItem
classes.description: Internal class representing a navigation item with icon, label, and builder function.

classes.name: _AdminSideBar
classes.description: Widget for the sidebar navigation menu with sign-out button.

classes.name: _AdminTopBar
classes.description: Widget for the top application bar displaying the title and user info.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes navigation routes, checks user session, and sets API logout callback.

methods.name: _checkSession
methods.description: Asynchronously reads authentication tokens to update session state.

methods.name: _signout
methods.description: Logs out the user and navigates to the login page.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree with either the admin layout or login page based on authentication state.
